_comment: PKT-005 degradation banner example payloads. Each example shows the meta fields from a composed view that drive a different banner variant.

fresh_no_banner._description: All surfaces ok — no banner displayed

degraded_banner._description: One surface degraded — show DEGRADED banner

stale_banner._description: Cache-served response — show STALE banner with age. Per-surface status is 'degraded' (not 'stale'). The STALE variant is triggered by meta.staleness.served_from='cache', which takes priority over the DEGRADED variant in the decision tree.

partial_banner._description: Mixed surface health — show PARTIAL banner listing each surface

split_read_pkt002_incident_home._description: PKT-002 Incident Home split-read merged surface map. incident_list comes from GET /api/v1/incidents; kill_switch comes from GET /api/v1/kill-switch/status. Because kill_switch is degraded, the DEGRADED banner renders.
split_read_pkt002_incident_home._note: This is a client-assembled merged map, not a single BFF response.

critical_bff_down._description: BFF request itself failed — show CRITICAL banner. This example represents a synthetic error state the client constructs when the fetch throws.
